fact: The OBSYDYA pilot observatory (March 2022 to December 2026, CIRAD with Benin's Ministry of Agriculture and INRAB as partners) builds satellite-imagery indicators of agricultural change for Borgou and northern Benin, to be hosted on a platform within the Ministry of Agriculture; the project is EU-funded and CIRAD-led.
title: Observatory of agricultural dynamics and rural landscapes in Benin (northern and central areas) - OBSYDYA
